config.channel.name: Announcement channel
config.channel.description: Channel where birthdays are announced. Nothing is announced until it is set.
config.role.name: Birthday role
config.role.description: Role given for the day to members whose birthday is announced. It is removed from everyone else at the next announcement.
config.timeZone.name: Time zone
config.timeZone.description: Time zone the server's days follow.
config.hour.name: Announcement hour
config.hour.description: Hour of the day (0 to 23) when the announcements are posted.
config.messages.name: Birthday messages
config.messages.description: Messages drawn at random to wish a happy birthday; {user} is replaced by the member. Empty: the built-in messages.
config.paradoxMilestones.name: Birthday paradox milestones
config.paradoxMilestones.description: Announce when the registrations reach the birthday paradox milestones (23 members, first shared date, 57 members).
announce.twins: 🎂 Today, {{users}} celebrate their birthday together. Happy birthday!
paradox.milestone.half: 🎲 **{{count}} birthdays registered.** It is now more likely than not that two of you share a birthday. That is the birthday paradox: it only takes 23 people to pass one chance in two.
paradox.milestone.certain: 🎲 **{{count}} birthdays registered.** The odds that two of you share a birthday now exceed 99%.
paradox.milestone.firstCollision_ordinal: 🎲 **First shared birthday!** Two members share a date since the {{count}}st registration. On average, the theory expects it at around {{expected}} registrations.
🎲 **First shared birthday!** Two members share a date since the {{count}}nd registration. On average, the theory expects it at around {{expected}} registrations.
🎲 **First shared birthday!** Two members share a date since the {{count}}rd registration. On average, the theory expects it at around {{expected}} registrations.
🎲 **First shared birthday!** Two members share a date since the {{count}}th registration. On average, the theory expects it at around {{expected}} registrations.
set.announcedLater: It will be announced once an announcement channel is set.
set.private: It will not be announced: it only counts in `/birthday stats`.
set.data: Only the day and the month are stored. `/birthday show` shows them, `/birthday remove` deletes them; leaving the server deletes them too.
show.none: You have not registered your birthday on this server.
show.announced: It is announced on the server.
show.private: It is not announced: it only counts in the statistics.
show.stored: That is all the module stores about you, with your Discord ID. `/birthday remove` deletes it.
remove.none: You had no birthday registered on this server.
upcoming.heading: 🎂 **Birthdays of the next {{count}} days**
upcoming.none: No birthday in the next {{count}} days.
stats.title: 🎲 **The birthday paradox, on this server**

stats.probability_other: **{{count}} birthdays registered** · theoretical odds that two share a date: **{{percent}}**
stats.noShared: On the server: no shared date yet.

stats.firstCollision_ordinal_one: The first shared date appeared at the {{count}}st registration; on average, the theory expects it at around {{expected}} registrations.

uninstall.warning_one: Disabling this module permanently deletes the **birthday** registered on this server. Only its member can register it again, with `/birthday set`.
uninstall.warning_other: Disabling this module permanently deletes the **{{count}} birthdays** registered on this server. Only the members can register them again, with `/birthday set`.
